verdict.rationale: A published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair things to ask of a SaaS work-management vendor like Wrike, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an uptime SLA, an availability commitment, or a status or incident page. The encryption-key, OAuth and webhook items are adjacent security and integration features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
